title: MONARK harness — recorded end-to-end demonstration

generated_by.grounding: step 7 of ROADMAP.md (first recorded 2026-09-11 for ADR-M005 H5 / C-6)

transport.mcp: MCP streamable-HTTP via createMcpHandler (SDK @modelcontextprotocol/server 2.3.1, the version apps/harness/package.json pins); a real JSON-RPC tools/call over a 127.0.0.1 socket; the response is framed as text/event-stream.
transport.http_mirror: HTTP/JSON mirror on the api. Host: the same registry and the same frozen input/output schemas.
transport.bind: 127.0.0.1, ephemeral port; the port is intentionally NOT recorded so this trace is reproducible byte-for-byte.
transport.accept_required: application/json, text/event-stream (a request missing text/event-stream is answered 406).
transport.session: stateless: tools/list and tools/call succeed with no session id; B_t is caller-carried in and out.
transport.protocol_version_negotiated: the client asks for 2026-07-28 and the SDK answers protocolVersion 2025-11-25 (step 1); an SDK observation, outside H5 scope.

honesty.calibration: committed: the USDe key of stable-run-velocity-24h, measured on calm-window redemption flow and measured non-stationary across half-years; no coverage is measured. btc-dir-15m is retired and its synthetic calibration is no longer served.
honesty.budget_bt: B_t is caller-carried: remainingBudget enters as a gate parameter and the SAME value leaves as remaining_budget. The stateless server does NOT deplete it (depletion would be monetisation, outside ADR-M005 scope, D6).
honesty.uncalibrated: under_calib: no calibration is committed for this predictor, so the gate abstains. That abstention is the honest, expected result, not a defect.
honesty.calibrate: calibrate computes a split-conformal quantile of the scores the caller supplies; it commits no calibration, serves no decision, and does not verify that the numbers are scores of any model.
honesty.vocabulary: no overclaim: this trace states no correctness claim; its only coverage statement is the calibrate label, conditional on exchangeability; it uses no forbidden vocabulary.

closes: The tools/call steps are real JSON-RPC requests over the streamable-HTTP transport, not tool.run() calls (H5 closed the residual 'seam SDK tools/call not exercised'). Since step 7 of ROADMAP.md they drive gate and calibrate; judge runs the Genkan kernel and is driven by the kernel tests (npm run test:genkan).

steps.label: committed-gate
steps.note: the committed USDe key of stable-run-velocity-24h, over its measured calibration (alpha and nMin imposed by the server; no coverage is measured): the committed decision.

content.text: a committed stable-run velocity calibration for the USDe synthetic-dollar-whitelisted-redeem population (key narabi:persistence-v2@eip155:1/erc20:0x4c9edd5852cd905f086c759e8383e09bff1e68b3) over calm-window redemption flow; coverage is stated under the split-conformal bound of Barber, Candes, Ramdas and Tibshirani 2023 (Thm 2, unit weights): at least 1 − α minus the average total-variation gap between calibration windows and the next one; that gap is not estimated here and the calibration is measured non-stationary across half-years, so 1 − α is the coverage only if that gap is zero (exchangeability), which is not assumed here; no coverage is measured; every other (task_class, predictor_id) abstains (under_calib); B_t is caller-carried. verdict action=commit reason=covered region=[-0.00003119228083333335, 0.00023119228083333336] qhat=0.00013119228083333334 n_calib=613 scores_sha256=e44a68b6...5cfd28

steps.label: calibrate
steps.note: split-conformal quantile of 20 caller-carried scores at alpha 0.1: the 19th smallest, rank ceil((n+1)(1-alpha)); nothing is committed and no decision is served.

content.text: split-conformal quantile at miscoverage α over caller-supplied nonconformity scores. MONARK does not see, store, or verify the caller's data or model, and does not validate that the supplied numbers are nonconformity scores of any model. Marginal 1−α coverage holds ONLY for future points exchangeable with the supplied scores; non-exchangeable data (e.g. distribution-shifted or time-ordered) voids it. Never a probability of being right. verdict qhat=0.36 n=20 alpha=0.1 scores_sha256=bc8f7250...47b147
